about.heading: ABOUT
about.intro: Convert-it is a free, open-source universal file converter that runs entirely in your browser. No uploads, no servers, no signups — your files never leave your device.
about.intro2: Built for developers, designers, and anyone who needs quick, private file conversions without the hassle of sketchy online tools or bloated desktop software.

step1.title: Drag & Drop
step1.desc: Drop your files or click to browse. Convert-it auto-detects the format and suggests available conversions.

step2.title: Customize
step2.desc: Tweak quality, delimiter, bitrate, or preset settings per file before converting.

step3.title: Download
step3.desc: Get your converted file instantly. Download individually or zip all results at once.

about.privacy1: Your files never leave your browser. All conversion happens locally using WebAssembly and the Canvas API. We don't upload, store, or have any access to your data.
about.privacy2: We run no analytics or tracking scripts — no cookies, no fingerprinting, and nothing tied to your files. The only things stored on your device are your theme and language preferences. Video and audio conversion downloads a ~31MB FFmpeg engine from our own CDN the first time you use it; your files are never part of that request. File size limits (100MB images, 500MB video, 200MB audio) prevent browser memory exhaustion.

about.improvement8: FFmpeg WASM error handling with graceful failure recovery
about.improvement9: Auto-generated conversion map — no manual sync between registry and UI
about.improvement10: Extracted job management into reusable useJobManager hook
about.improvement11: i18n support with 5 languages and dynamic locale loading
about.improvement12: Dark/light theme toggle with system preference detection
about.improvement13: Preview panel with copy-to-clipboard for text results
about.improvement15: PWA support with manifest and app icons
about.improvement16: Deduplicated FFmpeg progress tracking and MIME-type logic across video/audio conversion
about.improvement17: Unit test suite covering converters, job management, and i18n
about.improvement18: Self-hosted FFmpeg core on Cloudflare R2 — no third-party CDN in the conversion path
about.improvement19: No theme or language flash on first paint
about.improvement20: Works with browser storage blocked — theme, language, and history degrade instead of crashing
about.improvement21: Browser smoke suite that checks the downloaded bytes, not just that the UI turned green

about.improvement24: Fixed stale preview content when switching between converted results
about.improvement25: Image output encoded via jSquash WASM codecs (mozjpeg/libpng/libwebp) instead of canvas.toBlob — better quality, smaller files
about.improvement26: Lossless PNG optimization with oxipng (Rust) as a post-pass — smaller PNGs with zero quality loss
about.improvement27: SVG rasterization via resvg-wasm with a bundled Noto Sans font — renders real glyphs, no browser font variance
about.improvement28: PDF as input — convert PDF pages to PNG/JPG/WebP and extract text to TXT/HTML (pdfium-wasm)
about.improvement29: Multi-page PDF → image zip with 1×/2×/3× render scale (jszip)
about.improvement30: XML and HTML exports escape special characters and turn spreadsheet headers like “First Name” into valid tags; TXT, Markdown, and JSON → PDF keep their line breaks
about.improvement31: Video → WebM works again (VP8 + Vorbis), FFmpeg failures explain themselves, and progress follows the clip's real length
about.improvement32: Zip downloads no longer overwrite files that share a name, and HTML input is parsed without running any of its scripts
about.improvement33: Unicode PDFs: Greek, Cyrillic, Vietnamese, Chinese, Japanese and Korean now render as real text, and Markdown keeps its headings, lists, code, quotes and tables
about.improvement34: Fixed PDF → image colours (red and blue were swapped), and PDF pages can now be cropped, resized and compressed like any image
about.improvement35: ePub output passes the W3C validator and is split into chapters, with a table of contents, embedded images and the right language
about.improvement36: Real-world XML converts to CSV/TSV/YAML, Excel files convert every sheet, and large CSV files stream with live progress
about.improvement37: Video converts several times faster with your browser's built-in codecs, and FFmpeg takes over for anything they can't handle
about.improvement38: Works offline: install it as an app, converters you have used keep working without a connection, and “Save for offline use” caches the rest
about.improvement39: Clearer errors: a failed conversion says what went wrong (too large, out of memory, damaged file, engine not loaded) and what to try next
about.improvement40: Settings show only the options that affect your conversion (video output now has an audio bitrate), and “Add files” works after the first file
about.oss1: Convert-it is MIT-licensed and open source. The full codebase is available on GitHub. Contributions, bug reports, and feature requests are welcome.
about.improvement41: Video → GIF with a proper colour palette, and animated WebP, with frame rate, size and trim; trim any audio or video on a scrubber, and resize or mute video
about.improvement42: AVIF and JPEG XL output, and JPEG XL files can be opened
about.improvement43: PDF tools: pick, reorder, rotate or split pages, shrink scanned PDFs, turn images into PDFs, and merge several files into one
about.improvement44: See a photo's hidden metadata (location, camera, date) and choose to remove it, keep it, or keep it without the location
about.improvement45: Word documents: DOCX to HTML, Markdown, text, PDF or ePub, and Markdown, HTML or text to DOCX; tables now survive HTML → Markdown
about.improvement46: Read text from images and scanned PDFs (OCR) in eight languages, on your device
about.improvement47: Subtitles: SRT ⇄ WebVTT, fix their timing, or pull out a transcript
about.improvement48: Drop whole folders (their structure is kept in the zip), name outputs with templates like {name}-{w}x{h}, and dropped files are no longer added twice
about.improvement49: Cut a section out of the middle of a clip, and burn subtitles (.srt or .vtt, in any of the supported scripts) into a video

tooLarge.title: File too large ({size} MB; the limit is {limit} MB)
tooLarge.hint: Browsers can’t safely hold a file this big in memory. Try a shorter clip or a smaller image, or split the file.

outOfMemory.title: Ran out of memory
outOfMemory.hint: Your browser ran out of memory, or the converter crashed on this file. Close other tabs and press Retry, or try a smaller file or a lighter output format.

corruptInput.title: Couldn’t read this file
corruptInput.hint: It may be damaged, incomplete, or not really a .{ext} file. Try exporting it again from the app that made it.

unsupported.title: Not supported
unsupported.hint: This file uses something the converter can’t handle yet. Try a different output format.

engineLoad.title: Couldn’t load the converter
engineLoad.hint: Part of the conversion engine didn’t download. Check your connection and press Retry.

unknown.title: Conversion failed
unknown.hint: Something unexpected went wrong. Press Retry; if it keeps failing, the technical details below will help us fix it.

invalidSettings.title: This setting doesn’t fit the file
invalidSettings.hint: A setting on this job doesn’t work for this file; the details say which. Change it and press Retry.

unsupportedFile.title: Can’t convert .{label} files
unsupportedFile.titleNoExt: Can’t tell what this file is
unsupportedFile.image: {label} isn’t an image format this app reads. Export it as {formats} from the app that made it, then add that.
unsupportedFile.raw: Camera RAW needs a RAW developer. Export it as {formats} from your photo app first.
unsupportedFile.word: Save it as {formats} from your word processor, then convert that.
unsupportedFile.sheet: Save it as {formats} from your spreadsheet app, then convert that.
unsupportedFile.slides: Export the slides as {formats} from your presentation app; a PDF converts to images or text here.
unsupportedFile.archive: This is an archive. Unpack it first, then add the files (or the folder).
unsupportedFile.program: This is a program or installer, not a document: there is nothing to convert.
unsupportedFile.video: This video format isn’t read here yet. Export it as {formats} from the app that made it.
unsupportedFile.audio: This audio format isn’t read here yet. Export it as {formats} from the app that made it.
unsupportedFile.unknown: Its contents don’t match any format this app reads. If you know what it is, rename it with the right extension and add it again.

offline.failed: Couldn’t save for offline use. Try again when online.
